 Samsung S3 Essential (C310) 24” IPS Full HD Monitor – Performance Meets Elegance 

 Introducing the Samsung S3 Essential (C310) 24” Full HD IPS Monitor , a versatile display designed to enhance your everyday computing experience. Whether you’re working, gaming, streaming, or multitasking, this sleek and borderless monitor delivers a perfect balance of clarity, performance, and modern design. Engineered by Samsung, a global leader in display technology, the S3 Essential combines essential features with refined aesthetics, making it an ideal addition to any home or office setup.

 
 Stunning Visual Clarity in Full HD 

 The Samsung S3 Essential boasts a 24-inch flat IPS panel with a resolution of 1920 x 1080 (Full HD) . With over 2 million pixels on screen, every image and detail comes to life with incredible sharpness and clarity. Whether you’re viewing spreadsheets, watching your favorite movies, or editing photos, the monitor provides a crystal-clear experience that elevates your workflow and entertainment.

 The IPS (In-Plane Switching) panel ensures consistent and accurate colors from any angle, with a wide 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angle . This makes it perfect for collaborative work, presentations, or simply enjoying vivid visuals without color distortion—no matter where you sit.

 
 Smooth and Responsive Performance 

 Equipped with a 75Hz refresh rate and a fast 5ms (GTG) response time , the Samsung S3 Essential monitor ensures a smoother experience than traditional 60Hz displays. Whether you’re browsing the web, playing casual games, or streaming fast-paced videos, the screen keeps up with the action without lag or motion blur.

 Thanks to AMD FreeSync™ technology , the monitor minimizes screen tearing and stuttering during gaming or video playback by synchronizing the refresh rate with your GPU’s frame output. KOORUI G2511P 25” Gaming Monitor – 200Hz, Fast IPS, Full HD 1080P

 Elevate your gaming experience with the KOORUI G2511P — a premium 25-inch gaming monitor that combines lightning-fast performance with immersive visual clarity. Designed for competitive gamers and fast-paced action, this monitor features a stunning 200Hz refresh rate, 1ms response time, and Fast IPS technology — giving you everything you need to stay ahead of the game.

 Stunning Visual Performance

 The KOORUI G2511P boasts a 25-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) Fast IPS panel that delivers breathtaking clarity, sharpness, and color accuracy. Unlike traditional TN panels, the IPS technology ensures consistent brightness and color across wide viewing angles (178°), allowing you to enjoy the same high-quality visuals from any position.

 With a 90% DCI-P3 wide color gamut, this monitor reproduces more vibrant and realistic colors, making everything from gaming environments to video content look rich and lifelike. Whether you’re exploring fantasy worlds or streaming HD content, you’ll enjoy exceptional color fidelity and contrast.

 Blazing-Fast Refresh Rate and Response Time

 At the heart of the KOORUI G2511P lies its ultra-fast 200Hz refresh rate , which ensures smoother visuals and ultra-responsive gameplay. Every frame transitions seamlessly, virtually eliminating motion blur, ghosting, and stutter. This is particularly vital in competitive gaming genres such as FPS, racing, and eSports titles, where every millisecond counts.

 Combined with a 1ms MPRT (Moving Picture Response Time) , the monitor reacts almost instantly to your inputs, giving you an edge in real-time action. Shoot faster, react quicker, and game harder with a display built to keep up with your reflexes.

 Fast IPS – Color Meets Speed

 The “Fast IPS” technology used in the G2511P is specifically engineered to deliver the speed of a TN panel without compromising the color richness and viewing angles of IPS. This blend of performance and visual accuracy makes it perfect for gamers who need both precision and beauty in their display.

 Additionally, the monitor supports HDR400 , which increases dynamic range for deeper blacks, brighter whites, and more detail in both light and dark scenes. This enhances the realism and immersion of your games and movies alike.

 Adaptive Sync – Tear-Free Gaming

 Say goodbye to screen tearing and input lag. The KOORUI G2511P supports Adaptive Sync technology, including AMD FreeSync Premium, ensuring your GPU and monitor are always in sync. This allows for smoother gameplay, even during sudden frame rate drops, ensuring a more immersive and responsive experience.

 Whether you’re using AMD or NVIDIA graphics cards, this monitor adapts dynamically to deliver fluid visuals with no screen tearing or choppiness.

 Gamer-Focused Features

 KOORUI understands what gamers need, and the G2511P delivers:

 
• 
 Game modes for FPS, RTS, and RPG genres

• 
 Crosshair overlays to help improve aim

• 
 On-screen timers and refresh rate displays 

• 
 Low blue light mode for reduced eye fatigue during long sessions

• 
 Flicker-free technology to ensure stable images without backlight flicker

 
 Everything is designed to enhance your gameplay without distraction.

 Sleek, Functional Design

Incredible Speed for Competitive Gaming

 The KOORUI G2711P is engineered to meet the demanding needs of competitive gamers. Featuring an impressive 200Hz refresh rate combined with an ultra-fast 1ms Motion Picture Response Time (MPRT) , this monitor delivers ultra-smooth motion clarity that virtually eliminates motion blur and ghosting. This means fast-paced games like first-person shooters, racing simulators, and real-time strategy titles display crisp and fluid visuals, allowing you to react faster and play more effectively. The high refresh rate also reduces input lag, providing an edge in competitive gaming environments where every millisecond counts. Whether you’re dodging enemy fire or racing down the track at breakneck speeds, the KOORUI G2711P ensures your gameplay looks and feels buttery smooth.

 Stunning Color Accuracy with Fast IPS Technology

 At the heart of the G2711P lies a Fast IPS panel , which combines the speed of traditional TN panels with the superior color accuracy and wide viewing angles of IPS technology. This means you get vibrant, consistent colors even when viewing the screen from extreme angles — up to 178 degrees horizontally and vertically. The monitor covers approximately 99% of the sRGB color gamut and around 89% of the DCI-P3 color space , delivering true-to-life colors and deeper saturation. This makes the G2711P not only ideal for gaming but also suitable for content creators, photo editors, and multimedia enthusiasts who need reliable color accuracy in their daily workflow.

 VESA DisplayHDR 400 Certified for Dynamic Visuals

 To elevate your gaming and media experience, the KOORUI G2711P supports VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification . This feature enhances the dynamic range of images, making dark scenes richer and brighter areas more vivid without sacrificing detail. HDR content becomes more immersive thanks to higher peak brightness and improved contrast ratio. Whether you’re exploring shadowy dungeons, watching HDR-enabled movies, or playing visually rich AAA titles, the enhanced contrast and brightness offered by HDR 400 give you a noticeable boost in image quality, revealing subtle details that standard monitors miss.

 Adaptive Sync Technology for Tear-Free Gameplay

 Nothing ruins an immersive game like screen tearing or stuttering. The G2711P addresses this with support for both AMD FreeSync Premium and NVIDIA G-Sync compatibility . These adaptive sync technologies work by synchronizing the monitor’s refresh rate with the frame rate output of your graphics card. This synchronization eliminates the tearing artifacts and stutter caused by mismatched frame rates, ensuring a smoother and more visually coherent experience. Whether you’re running an AMD Radeon or NVIDIA GeForce GPU, you benefit from a buttery-smooth frame delivery that maintains high responsiveness.

 Immersive 27-Inch Full HD Display

 The 27-inch diagonal screen size strikes an excellent balance between immersion and desktop space. The Full HD resolution of 1920×1080 pixels provides sharp and detailed visuals, while the fast IPS panel ensures vibrant colors and wide viewing angles. The monitor features an ultra-thin bezel design on three sides, which minimizes distractions and makes it an excellent choice for multi-monitor setups. Whether you’re gaming, watching videos, or working, the large screen real estate combined with crisp resolution and minimal bezels enhances your overall viewing experience.

 Designed for Comfort and Versatility

 Ergonomics and comfort are priorities in the design of the KOORUI G2711P. The monitor stand supports tilt adjustment, allowing you to find the perfect viewing angle that reduces neck and eye strain during long gaming or work sessions. For users seeking more flexibility, the monitor also supports a VESA 75×75 mm mount , making it compatible with a wide range of monitor arms and wall mounts. Samsung Odyssey G5 G53F 27″ QHD 200Hz IPS Gaming Monitor

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 27 G53F is a high-speed QHD gaming monitor designed for players who want a strong combination of image detail, fast refresh rate and responsive gameplay. The exact regional model is LS27FG532EMXUE , featuring a 27-inch flat IPS panel , 2560 × 1440 QHD resolution , maximum 200Hz refresh rate , and 1ms MPRT response time .

 Compared with a standard Full HD gaming monitor, the QHD resolution provides around 1.7 times the pixel density of 1920 × 1080, giving games, text and desktop content noticeably sharper detail while maintaining a practical 27-inch screen size. Samsung positions the G53F as a gaming-focused Odyssey display, with features including AMD FreeSync Premium, Black Equalizer, Virtual Aim Point and Auto Source Switch.

 27-Inch QHD Gaming Display

 2560 × 1440 Resolution

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 G53F uses a native QHD resolution of 2560 × 1440 with a traditional 16:9 aspect ratio .

 Samsung highlights QHD as one of the monitor’s main features because it provides considerably more image detail than Full HD while remaining easier to drive at high frame rates than 4K. This makes the resolution particularly attractive for gaming PCs equipped with modern mid-range and high-performance graphics cards.

 The active display area measures 596.736 × 335.664mm , giving the monitor a conventional 27-inch desktop footprint suitable for gaming, productivity and entertainment.

 IPS Panel with Wide Viewing Angles

 Consistent Colours Across the Screen

 The Samsung LS27FG532 uses an IPS panel , offering wide 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles .

 Samsung specifies typical brightness of 300 cd/m² , minimum brightness of 240 cd/m² and a typical static contrast ratio of 1000:1 . The display supports up to 16.7 million colours and Samsung lists NTSC 1976 colour gamut coverage of 72% or higher.

 IPS technology makes the monitor suitable for users who value consistent colour and image quality across different viewing positions while still wanting a high-refresh gaming display.

 200Hz Refresh Rate

 Smooth High-Speed Gaming

 One of the biggest advantages of this 200Hz Gaming Monitor is its maximum refresh rate of 200Hz .

 A higher refresh rate allows compatible hardware to display more frames per second than conventional 60Hz, 75Hz, 120Hz or 144Hz monitors. This can make motion appear smoother and controls feel more responsive when the gaming PC can produce sufficiently high frame rates.

 The 200Hz specification makes the Odyssey G5 particularly interesting for competitive titles such as shooters, racing games and esports titles where fast movement and rapid input response are important.

 1ms MPRT Response Time

 Fast Motion Clarity

 Samsung specifies a 1ms MPRT response time for the G53F.

 This feature is designed to improve motion clarity during fast gameplay and reduce visible blur in rapid scenes. Samsung notes that actual response behaviour can depend on monitor settings, content and testing conditions.

 Combined with the 200Hz refresh rate, the fast response specification gives the monitor a gaming-oriented performance profile rather than simply focusing on resolution and image quality.

 AMD FreeSync Premium

 Reduced Tearing and Stutter

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 G53F supports AMD FreeSync Premium .

 This variable refresh rate technology allows the monitor and a compatible graphics processor to better synchronise their refresh behaviour. The goal is to reduce screen tearing, stuttering and interruptions when frame rates change during gameplay.

 For gamers using compatible AMD graphics hardware, FreeSync Premium provides an additional advantage when frame rates fluctuate instead of remaining fixed at the monitor’s maximum refresh rate.

 HDR10 Support

 Improved Highlight and Shadow Detail

Samsung Odyssey G5 (FG502E) (2026) 32″ Flat Monitor IPS 2K (2560 x 1440) 180Hz 1ms(GTG), HDR10, 99% sRGB, 8 Bit, G-Sync Compatible w/ Ergonomic Stand | LS32FG502

 The Samsung Odyssey G5 (FG502E / G50F) 32″ 2K QHD Fast IPS Gaming Monitor (LS32FG502) sets a new benchmark for competitive mid-range 1440p gaming. Replacing older VA-based designs with a premium flat Fast IPS panel, this display eliminates black smearing and dark-level motion blur to deliver clean frame transitions. Featuring Quad HD resolution (2560 x 1440) across an expansive 32-inch screen canvas, a swift 180Hz refresh rate, and a true 1ms (GTG) pixel response time, the G5 FG502E ensures high-speed visual performance without compromising color precision or visual detail.

 Equipped with 99% sRGB color gamut coverage, true 8-bit color depth (16.7M colors), and HDR10 dynamic decoding, this display reproduces vivid, lifelike environments with high contrast stability. Dual adaptive synchronization via NVIDIA G-Sync Compatibility and AMD FreeSync maintains tear-free, stutter-free gameplay during peak graphical output. Complete with a fully ergonomic height-adjustable stand supporting tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustments, the LS32FG502 provides a versatile, feature-rich 2K display tailored for competitive multiplayer titles and immersive content creation.

 
 
 

 

 
 Expansive 32-Inch 2K QHD Flat Fast IPS Display

 Superior Motion Clarity and Rich Visual Detail

 Experience immersive visual performance on a spacious 32-inch flat screen canvas. Featuring 2K Quad HD (2560 x 1440) resolution, the Odyssey G5 provides 1.7 times the pixel density of standard Full HD monitors, offering extended visual real estate for complex game environments and multitasking work windows.

 Upgraded with Fast IPS panel technology, this display delivers wide 178-degree viewing angles while effectively eliminating dark-level ghosting and black smearing typical of traditional entry-level displays.

 

 
 180Hz Refresh Rate & True 1ms (GTG) Pixel Response

 Butter-Smooth Frame Transitions for Fast-Paced Action

 Dominating fast-moving game scenes is effortless with a rapid 180Hz refresh rate over DisplayPort connections. Displaying up to 180 frames per second, camera snaps, target tracking, and rapid motion vectors remain crisp and fluid.

 Paired with a true 1ms (Grey-to-Grey) response time, pixel color state changes happen virtually instantaneously. Motion blur, trailing artifacts, and screen haze are minimized to give you an immediate tactical edge in FPS, MOBA, and racing games.

 

 
 True 8-Bit Color Depth with 99% sRGB & HDR10

 Accurate Color Fidelity and Dynamic Scene Contrast

 Enjoy vibrant, true-to-life colors with 99% sRGB color spectrum coverage and a true 8-bit color depth rendering 16.7 million distinct shades. Texture details, character shaders, and game environments appear rich and accurate.

 HDR10 high dynamic range support boosts scene contrast by brightening highlight zones and deepening shadowed background areas, exposing fine details hidden in dark corners.

 

 
 NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible & AMD FreeSync

 Seamless Tear-Free and Stutter-Free Frame Delivery

 Keep screen tearing, frame stuttering, and input delay out of your gameplay. The Odyssey G5 dynamically synchronizes its 180Hz refresh rate with output frame rates from both NVIDIA GeForce and AMD Radeon graphics cards.

 This adaptive synchronization delivers smooth and uninterrupted frame flow during intense gameplay, even when frame rates fluctuate during heavy graphic renders.

ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A: Exceptional Gaming Performance in a Stunning Display 

 The ASUS TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A is a high-performance gaming monitor designed to provide smooth and immersive visuals for serious gamers. With a 27-inch 2K display, a fast 180Hz refresh rate, and a 1ms response time, this monitor is optimized for fast-paced gaming and competitive esports. Featuring G-Sync compatibility and an IPS panel, it ensures vibrant colors and sharp details while minimizing screen tearing and stuttering. Whether you're into fast shooters or action-packed RPGs, the TUF Gaming VG27AQ3A delivers an ultra-responsive and visually stunning gaming experience.

 
 

 Key Features

 27" 2K (2560x1440) Resolution 

 
• The 2K resolution offers a perfect balance between Full HD and 4K, providing sharp visuals without taxing your system.

• Ideal for gamers who want a crisp, detailed picture for a more immersive gaming experience.

 
 180Hz Refresh Rate 

 
• With an ultra-fast 180Hz refresh rate, the VG27AQ3A ensures incredibly smooth and fluid gameplay, reducing motion blur and making it perfect for high-speed gaming.

• Perfect for fast-paced games like first-person shooters (FPS), racing games, and action games.

 
 1ms Response Time 

 
• The 1ms response time minimizes ghosting and blurring, ensuring fast and responsive gameplay.

• Get ahead of your competition with the speed and precision that competitive gaming demands.

 
 Fast IPS Technology 

 
• The Fast IPS panel delivers excellent color accuracy and wide viewing angles, ensuring vibrant and true-to-life visuals across the entire screen.

• Enjoy rich, consistent colors and detailed images with minimal color shift.

 
 G-Sync Compatibility 

 
• G-Sync eliminates screen tearing and stuttering by synchronizing the monitor's refresh rate with your NVIDIA GPU, resulting in smoother gameplay.

• Ideal for competitive gaming, where every frame matters.

 
 High Dynamic Range (HDR) Support 

 
• HDR support enhances contrast and color, bringing deeper blacks and brighter whites to your screen for more lifelike visuals.

• Experience more realistic and immersive gaming scenes.

 
 Ergonomic Design and Adjustable Stand 

 
• The monitor comes with an ergonomic stand that allows for tilt, swivel, height adjustment, and pivot, so you can customize it to your preferred viewing angle.

• Reduce neck and eye strain during long gaming sessions with a comfortable, adjustable setup.

 
 Extensive Connectivity Options 

 
• The VG27AQ3A offers a variety of input ports, including DisplayPort 1.2 and HDMI 2.0, ensuring compatibility with multiple devices, such as gaming consoles, PCs, and more.

• Connect your preferred devices with ease, whether you're gaming on your PC or console.

 
 Eye Care Technology 

 
• ASUS Eye Care technology reduces blue light and flicker, providing a more comfortable viewing experience during extended gaming sessions.

• Protect your eyes from strain and fatigue without compromising image quality.

Samsung Odyssey G6 G60F 27″ QHD 350Hz IPS Gaming Monitor

 The Samsung Odyssey G6 27 G60F is a high-performance gaming monitor designed for players who want extremely fast refresh rates without dropping back to Full HD resolution. The exact Middle East model LS27FG600EMXUE combines a 27-inch flat IPS panel , 2560 × 1440 QHD resolution , a maximum 350Hz refresh rate , and an ultra-fast 1ms GTG response time .

 This combination makes the Odyssey G6 particularly attractive for competitive PC gaming. QHD delivers significantly more image detail than 1080p, while the 350Hz refresh rate is designed for gamers using powerful systems capable of producing very high frame rates.

 27-Inch QHD Gaming Display

 2560 × 1440 Resolution

 The Odyssey G6 uses a native QHD resolution of 2560 × 1440 pixels with a standard 16:9 aspect ratio .

 At 27 inches, QHD provides a strong balance between screen size, image sharpness and GPU performance requirements. It delivers substantially more workspace and detail than Full HD while remaining less demanding than 4K when targeting very high frame rates.

 Samsung specifies an active display area of 596.736 × 335.664mm , making this a conventional 27-inch desktop display suitable for competitive gaming as well as general productivity and multimedia.

 Fast IPS Panel

 Wide Viewing Angles and 99% sRGB

 The Samsung LS27FG600 uses an IPS panel with wide 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles .

 Samsung lists typical brightness at 350 cd/m² , minimum brightness at 280 cd/m² and a typical static contrast ratio of 1000:1 . The monitor supports up to 16.7 million colours and provides 99% sRGB coverage .

 That combination makes the G6 suitable for users who want competitive gaming performance while retaining strong colour reproduction and consistent viewing characteristics.

 350Hz Refresh Rate

 Extreme Speed for Competitive Gaming

 The biggest performance feature of the Odyssey G6 G60F is its maximum 350Hz refresh rate .

 A 350Hz panel can refresh the displayed image up to 350 times per second when connected to compatible hardware and when the game is producing sufficient frame rates. That can provide smoother motion and lower perceived latency than conventional 60Hz, 144Hz, 165Hz, 180Hz or 240Hz monitors.

 Samsung specifically positions the 350Hz refresh rate as a competitive-gaming feature intended to minimize delay and improve responsiveness during fast gameplay.

 1ms GTG Response Time

 Fast Pixel Response

 Samsung officially rates the G60F at 1ms GTG response time .

 GTG, or Gray-to-Gray, measures how quickly individual pixels transition between different shades. Faster pixel transitions can help reduce visible ghosting and motion blur during rapid camera movements.

 Samsung notes that the 1ms result is measured under internal test conditions using the monitor’s Extreme mode , and actual performance can vary according to settings and content.

 NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible

 Smooth NVIDIA Gaming

 The Odyssey G6 is officially listed as NVIDIA G-Sync Compatible .

 With a compatible NVIDIA graphics card, the monitor can synchronize its refresh behaviour with the GPU to reduce visible screen tearing, stuttering and choppy motion as frame rates fluctuate.

 This makes it a particularly strong match for gaming PCs equipped with modern NVIDIA GeForce graphics cards.

 AMD FreeSync Premium

 Variable Refresh Rate for AMD GPUs

 Samsung also includes AMD FreeSync Premium , giving the monitor variable refresh rate support for compatible AMD Radeon graphics hardware.

 This means the G6 supports adaptive synchronization across both major gaming GPU platforms, providing greater flexibility when choosing or upgrading a graphics card.

 VESA DisplayHDR 400

 HDR Gaming Support

 The Samsung Odyssey G6 G60F carries VESA DisplayHDR 400 certification.

Samsung Odyssey G7 G70D 32″ 4K 144Hz Gaming Monitor LS32DG702

 The Samsung Odyssey G7 LS32DG702 is a premium 32-inch gaming monitor designed for gamers who want the combination of 4K UHD resolution, a fast IPS panel, 144Hz refresh rate and 1ms GTG response time in one large-screen display.

 Samsung officially lists the LS32DG702 as a 32-inch flat Odyssey G7 G70D with a native resolution of 3840 × 2160 , delivering four times the pixel count of Full HD. With its combination of high resolution and fast refresh rate, the monitor is suitable for gaming PCs, modern consoles, competitive gaming and high-quality multimedia use.

 32-Inch 4K UHD Gaming Display

 Sharp 3840 × 2160 Resolution

 The Odyssey G7 G70D uses a 32-inch 16:9 display with a native 4K UHD resolution of 3840 × 2160 pixels .

 The larger 32-inch screen gives games, movies and productivity applications more visual space, while the 4K resolution delivers significantly finer detail than standard 1080p displays.

 Samsung specifies an active display area of 698.112 × 392.688mm , making the G7 suitable for users who prefer a large desktop gaming experience without moving into ultrawide formats.

 Fast IPS Panel

 Wide Viewing Angles and Rich Colour

 Samsung equips the LS32DG702 with a Fast IPS panel .

 The display offers 178° horizontal and vertical viewing angles , allowing colours and image quality to remain consistent even when the screen is viewed from the side.

 Samsung rates typical brightness at 350 cd/m² , static contrast at 1000:1 , support for up to 1 billion colours , and 99% sRGB coverage . These specifications make the monitor useful not only for gaming but also for general multimedia and everyday visual work.

 144Hz Refresh Rate and 1ms GTG

 Smooth and Responsive Gaming

 One of the main advantages of the Samsung Odyssey G7 32 is its combination of high resolution and gaming speed.

 Samsung officially specifies a maximum refresh rate of 144Hz , allowing compatible PCs and consoles to display up to 144 refreshes per second.

 Response time is rated at 1ms GTG , helping reduce visible motion blur during fast-paced gameplay. Samsung notes that the measured 1ms GTG result depends on monitor settings and test conditions.

 This makes the monitor suitable for fast-moving titles including racing, shooters, action games and competitive multiplayer games while still retaining the visual detail of a 4K panel.

 AMD FreeSync Premium and G-Sync Compatibility

 Smoother Variable Refresh Rate Gaming

 The Samsung LS32DG702 officially supports AMD FreeSync Premium and is also listed by Samsung as G-Sync Compatible .

 Variable refresh rate technology helps synchronise the display refresh rate with compatible graphics hardware, reducing visual tearing and stuttering when frame rates change during gaming.

 For users building a powerful gaming PC with an NVIDIA GeForce or AMD Radeon graphics card, this gives the G7 broader compatibility for smoother gameplay.

 VESA DisplayHDR 400

 HDR Gaming and Improved Dynamic Range

 Samsung certifies the monitor for VESA DisplayHDR 400 and also lists support for HDR10+ Gaming .

 HDR support improves the monitor’s ability to display differences between bright and dark areas in compatible HDR content, while Samsung’s HDR gaming features are designed to enhance supported gaming experiences.

 The combination of 4K resolution, IPS colour performance and HDR support gives the G7 a stronger visual feature set than basic high-refresh gaming monitors.

 HDMI 2.1 and DisplayPort 1.4

 Modern PC and Console Connectivity

 The Odyssey G7 LS32DG702 offers excellent connectivity for gaming setups.

 Samsung officially provides:

 
• 2 × HDMI 2.1 

• 1 × DisplayPort 1.4 

• 2 × USB 3.0 hub ports 

• 1 × USB-B upstream 

• Ethernet LAN 

• Wi-Fi 5 

• Bluetooth 5.2 

 
 HDMI 2.1 makes the monitor particularly useful for current gaming hardware that benefits from high-resolution, high-refresh-rate connectivity.

 Smart Gaming Monitor Featur

 Game at the speed of OLED with an ultra-fast 240Hz and near instantaneous 0.03ms (GtG) response time. The faster speed lets you respond quickly to opponents and enjoy smoother scenes with less lag or ghosting.

 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 Your Favorite Streaming Services Plus Cloud Gaming

 
 Thanks to webOS24, find your favorites fast with built-in access to Netflix, Prime Video, the Apple TV app, Disney+, HBO Max.  Low Glare, More Focus: Play Without Distractions
